en.B: For the music director. Of David. A psalm.
en.R: For the leader of the music. A song by David.

fr.B: Au chef de chœur. De David. Psaume.

hi.B: संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए। दाऊद का। भजन।

ja.B: 音楽を導く者のために。ダビデによる。賛歌。

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1.

decisions.choice: Psalm 40:14-18 is also Psalm 70
decisions.reason: The last five verses of this psalm appear again, with small changes, as Psalm 70. A prayer of thanks (verses 2-11) turns into a cry for help (verses 12-18).

decisions.choice: "다윗의 [시]. 시." at Literal; "다윗의 시" at Balanced
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "Of David. A psalm." in that order. Literal keeps both parts and supplies the noun the Korean genitive needs; Balanced joins them into the usual "다윗의 시".

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 40
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: Psalm 40:14-18 drafted here for Psalm 70 as well
decisions.reason: Verses 14-18 are also Psalm 70 (m3). Psalm 70 is not yet drafted in Hindi, so these verses are drafted here first, and Psalm 70 is to keep their wording at each level where its Hebrew is the same. The title follows the poetry note's table, as in Psalms 36, 38 and 39.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans; "तू" to God
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans where the English has them. The psalm speaks to God with "तू" and of him in the honorific third person.

decisions.choice: verses 14-18 drafted here for Psalm 70
decisions.reason: Psalm 40:14-18 is also Psalm 70 (m3). The Russian is drafted here first; Psalm 70 is to keep this wording at each level and differ only where its Hebrew differs.

decisions.choice: Psalm 40:14-18 is worded so that Psalm 70:2-6 can repeat it where the Hebrew is the same
decisions.reason: The two passages share their Hebrew (m3); the Psalter's rule is the same Japanese for the same Hebrew (PSA_GUIDE). ledavid mizmor ダビデによる。賛歌。 (L, B) as 24:1 (PSA-3).

source.text: קַוֺּ֣ה קִוִּ֣יתִי יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥ט אֵ֝לַ֗י וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע שַׁוְעָתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Waiting I waited [for] YHWH, and he inclined to me and heard my cry.

en.L: Waiting, I waited for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} inclined to me and heard my cry.
en.B: I waited and kept on waiting for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} bent down toward me and listened to my cry for help.
en.R: I waited and waited for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to help me. \q Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} leaned down to me and heard me cry out.

fr.L: Espérant, j’ai espéré {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est penché vers moi et a entendu mon cri.
fr.B: J’ai attendu, et attendu encore {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est penché vers moi et a écouté mon appel au secours.
fr.R: J’ai attendu longtemps que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vienne m’aider. \q Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est penché vers moi et m’a entendu crier.

sw.L: Kungoja nilimngojea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akaniinamia na kusikia kilio changu.
sw.B: Nilimngojea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nikaendelea kumngojea, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akaniinamia na kukisikiliza kilio changu cha kuomba msaada.
sw.R: Nilimngojea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa muda mrefu anisaidie. Kisha akaniinamia na kunisikia nikilia.

es.L: Esperando, esperé {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se inclinó hacia mí y oyó mi clamor.
es.B: Esperé y seguí esperando {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se inclinó hacia mí y escuchó mi grito de auxilio.
es.R: Esperé y esperé a que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ayudara. \q Entonces {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se inclinó hacia mí y me oyó clamar.

vi.L: Trông đợi, tôi đã trông đợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nghiêng mình xuống cùng tôi và nghe tiếng kêu của tôi.
vi.B: Tôi đã trông đợi, cứ mãi trông đợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cúi xuống gần tôi và lắng nghe tiếng tôi kêu cứu.
vi.R: Tôi đã chờ đợi mãi để {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp tôi. Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cúi xuống gần tôi và nghe tôi kêu cứu.

ko.L: 기다리고 기다렸더니 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 몸을 기울이시고 내 부르짖음을 들으셨다.
ko.B: 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 기다리고 또 기다렸더니, 그분께서 나에게로 몸을 굽히시고 도와 달라는 내 부르짖음을 들어 주셨다.
ko.R: 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나를 도와주시기를 기다리고 또 기다렸다. 그러자 그분께서 나에게 몸을 굽히시고 내 부르짖음을 들으셨다.

pt.L: Esperando, esperei {{divine_name:pelo SENHOR|por Javé}}, \q e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se inclinou para mim e ouviu o meu clamor.
pt.B: Esperei e continuei esperando {{divine_name:pelo SENHOR|por Javé}}, \q e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se inclinou para mim e escutou o meu pedido de socorro.
pt.R: Esperei e esperei que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me ajudasse. \q Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se inclinou para mim e me ouviu gritar.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ተጠባብቄ ተጠባበቅኩት፤ እርሱም ወደ እኔ ዘንበል አለ፤ ጩኸቴንም ሰማ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ተጠባበቅኩ፤ መጠባበቄንም ቀጠልኩ፤ እርሱም ወደ እኔ ዝቅ ብሎ የእርዳታ ጩኸቴን ሰማ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲረዳኝ ብዙ ጊዜ ጠበቅኩ። ከዚያም ወደ እኔ ዘንበል ብሎ ጩኸቴን ሰማ።

hi.L: मैं धीरज से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की बाट जोहता रहा, और उन्होंने मेरी ओर झुककर मेरी दुहाई सुनी।
hi.B: मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की बाट जोहता रहा, जोहता ही रहा, और उन्होंने मेरी ओर झुककर सहायता के लिए मेरी पुकार सुनी।
hi.R: मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की सहायता की बाट जोहता रहा, जोहता ही रहा। तब वे मेरी ओर झुके और उन्होंने मेरी पुकार सुनी।

ru.L: Ожидая, я ожидал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} склонился ко мне и услышал вопль мой.
ru.B: Я ждал и всё ждал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} наклонился ко мне и услышал мой крик о помощи.
ru.R: Я долго-долго ждал, чтобы {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} помог мне. Тогда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} наклонился ко мне и услышал, как я кричу.

ja.L: 待ち望みに待ち望んだ、わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を。すると、その方はわたしに身を傾け、わたしの叫びを聞かれた。
ja.B: わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を待ち望み、ひたすら待ち続けた。その方はわたしのほうに身をかがめ、助けを求める叫びに耳を傾けてくださった。
ja.R: わたしは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が助けてくださるのを、ずっと待っていた。すると、その方はわたしのほうに身をかがめて、わたしの叫びを聞いてくださった。

uk.L: Чекаючи, я чекав на {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} нахилився до мене й почув мій крик.
uk.B: Я чекав і чекав на {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} схилився до мене й вислухав мій заклик про допомогу.
uk.R: Я довго чекав, що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} допоможе мені. І ось {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} нахилився до мене й почув, як я кличу.

decisions.choice: Waiting I waited: I waited long and hard
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled (an infinitive with the same verb), which makes it strong: he waited steadily, with hope fixed on the LORD. The word (qavah) is the waiting of hope (27:14).

decisions.choice: he inclined to me: he bent down to listen
decisions.reason: The verb is used of bending the ear to hear (17:6; 31:3). The LORD stoops to the one who calls.

decisions.choice: "Trông đợi, tôi đã trông đợi" (waiting, I waited)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew doubles the verb to say he waited long and hard (see the meaning decision); Literal keeps the doubling so the reader sees it, and Balanced says "cứ mãi trông đợi" (kept on waiting).

decisions.choice: Verses 2-5 tell of the LORD in the plain written style with "나"; from verse 6 the psalm is spoken to God in 합쇼체 with "저", and "we" is "저희"
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7a. Verses 2-5 are testimony about the LORD before others; verse 6 turns to address "LORD my God". Within the prayer, the words quoted in verses 8-9 are also spoken to God, so they are 합쇼체 too.

decisions.choice: "धीरज से ... बाट जोहता रहा" (L); "जोहता रहा, जोहता ही रहा" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew doubles the verb ("waiting I waited") to say he waited long (m1). Hindi cannot double the verb in the same way: Literal says it with "धीरज से" and the continuous "जोहता रहा", Balanced and Readable repeat the verb, as the English does.

decisions.choice: qawwoh qiwwiti "待ち望みに待ち望んだ" (L), "待ち望み、ひたすら待ち続けた" (B), "ずっと待っていた" (R)
decisions.reason: The doubled verb means I waited long and hard (m1); Literal imitates the doubling, the Psalter's qavah 待ち望む (PSA-3).

source.text: וַיַּעֲלֵ֤נִי׀מִבּ֥וֹר שָׁאוֹן֮ מִטִּ֪יט הַיָּ֫וֵ֥ן וַיָּ֖קֶם עַל־סֶ֥לַע רַגְלַ֗י כּוֹנֵ֥ן אֲשֻׁרָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And he brought me up from a pit of roaring, from the mud of the mire, and set on a rock my feet; he made firm my steps.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brought me up from a pit of roaring, from the mud of the mire, and set my feet on a rock; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made my steps firm.
en.B: He drew me up from the roaring pit, out of the clinging mud; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} planted my feet on a rock and steadied my steps.
en.R: He pulled me up out of a deep, noisy pit, out of the sticky mud. \q He set me on solid rock, so that I could walk without slipping.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a fait monter d’une fosse de vacarme, de la boue du bourbier, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a placé mes pieds sur un rocher ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a affermi mes pas.
fr.B: Il m’a tiré de la fosse grondante, de la vase qui colle ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a posé mes pieds sur un rocher et a rendu mes pas assurés.
fr.R: Il m’a tiré d’un trou profond et bruyant, hors de la boue qui colle. \q Il m’a mis sur un rocher solide, pour que je puisse marcher sans glisser.

sw.L: Naye akanipandisha kutoka katika shimo la kelele, kutoka katika matope ya utelezi, akaisimamisha miguu yangu juu ya mwamba; akaziimarisha hatua zangu.
sw.B: Alinivuta juu kutoka katika shimo lenye kelele za maji, kutoka katika matope yanayonata; akaipandikiza miguu yangu juu ya mwamba na kuziimarisha hatua zangu.
sw.R: Alinivuta juu kutoka katika shimo refu lenye kelele, kutoka katika matope yanayonata. Aliniweka juu ya mwamba imara, ili niweze kutembea bila kuteleza.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me hizo subir de una fosa de estruendo, del lodo del pantano, y puso mis pies sobre una roca; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} afirmó mis pasos.
es.B: Él me sacó de la fosa rugiente, del barro pegajoso; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} plantó mis pies sobre una roca y dio firmeza a mis pasos.
es.R: Él me sacó de un pozo hondo y ruidoso, del lodo pegajoso. \q Me puso sobre una roca firme, para que pudiera caminar sin resbalar.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đem tôi lên khỏi hố gầm thét, khỏi bùn của vũng lầy, và đặt chân tôi trên vầng đá; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho các bước của tôi vững vàng.
vi.B: Ngài kéo tôi lên khỏi hố sâu gầm thét, ra khỏi vũng bùn lầy dính chặt; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đặt chân tôi trên vầng đá và giữ cho bước tôi vững vàng.
vi.R: Ngài kéo tôi lên khỏi một cái hố sâu và ồn ào, ra khỏi lớp bùn dính nhớp. Ngài đặt tôi trên vầng đá vững chắc, để tôi có thể bước đi mà không trượt ngã.

ko.L: 그분께서 나를 요란한 구덩이에서, 진흙 수렁에서 끌어올리시고, 내 발을 반석 위에 두시며, 내 걸음을 굳게 하셨다.
ko.B: 그분께서 나를 물소리 요란한 구덩이에서, 발이 빠지는 진흙에서 건져 올리시고, 내 발을 반석 위에 세우셔서 내 걸음을 든든하게 하셨다.
ko.R: 그분께서 깊고 시끄러운 구덩이에서, 끈적한 진흙 속에서 나를 끌어올리셨다. 그분께서 나를 단단한 반석 위에 세우셔서 미끄러지지 않고 걷게 하셨다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me tirou de uma cova de estrondo, do lodo do pântano, e pôs os meus pés sobre uma rocha; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} firmou os meus passos.
pt.B: Ele me puxou para fora da cova barulhenta, da lama que prende; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} firmou os meus pés numa rocha e deu segurança aos meus passos.
pt.R: Ele me puxou para fora de um buraco fundo e barulhento, para fora da lama grudenta. \q Ele me pôs sobre uma rocha firme, para que eu pudesse andar sem escorregar.

am.L: ከሚያስገመግም ጉድጓድ፣ ከረግረግ ጭቃም አወጣኝ፤ እግሮቼንም በዓለት ላይ አቆመ፤ አረማመዴንም አጸና።
am.B: ከሚጮኸው ጉድጓድ፣ ከሚያጣብቀው ጭቃ ጎትቶ አወጣኝ፤ እግሮቼን በዓለት ላይ ተከለ፤ እርምጃዬንም አጸና።
am.R: ጥልቅና ጫጫታ ካለበት ጉድጓድ፣ ከሚያጣብቅ ጭቃ ውስጥ ጎትቶ አወጣኝ። ሳልንሸራተት እንድሄድ በጠንካራ ዓለት ላይ አቆመኝ።

hi.L: और उन्होंने मुझे गरजते हुए गड्ढे से, दलदल की कीचड़ से निकाला, और मेरे पाँवों को चट्टान पर खड़ा किया; उन्होंने मेरे क़दमों को स्थिर किया।
hi.B: उन्होंने मुझे गरजते गड्ढे से, चिपकनेवाली कीचड़ में से ऊपर खींच लिया; उन्होंने मेरे पाँव चट्टान पर जमा दिए और मेरे क़दमों को स्थिर किया।
hi.R: उन्होंने मुझे एक गहरे, शोर भरे गड्ढे से, चिपचिपी कीचड़ में से बाहर खींच निकाला। उन्होंने मुझे पक्की चट्टान पर खड़ा किया, ताकि मैं बिना फिसले चल सकूँ।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} поднял меня из шумящей ямы, из тинистой грязи, и поставил на скале ноги мои; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} утвердил шаги мои.
ru.B: Он вытащил меня из ревущей ямы, из вязкой грязи; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} поставил мои ноги на скалу и укрепил мои шаги.
ru.R: Он вытащил меня из глубокой, шумной ямы, из липкой грязи. Он поставил меня на твёрдую скалу, чтобы я мог идти и не скользить.

ja.L: そして、その方はわたしを騒ぎの穴から、泥沼の泥から引き上げ、わたしの足を岩の上に立たせ、わたしの歩みを確かにされた。
ja.B: その方は、とどろく滅びの穴から、からみつく泥の中から、わたしを引き上げてくださった。わたしの足を岩の上に据え、わたしの歩みを確かにしてくださった。
ja.R: その方は、水がごうごうと鳴る深い穴から、ねばねばした泥の中から、わたしを引き上げてくださった。わたしをしっかりした岩の上に立たせ、滑らずに歩けるようにしてくださった。

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} вивів мене з ями ревіння, з болотяного багна, і поставив мої ноги на скелю; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} утвердив мої кроки.
uk.B: Він витягнув мене з ревучої ями, з липкого болота; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} поставив мої ноги на скелю й зміцнив мої кроки.
uk.R: Він витягнув мене з глибокої, гучної ями, з липкого болота. Він поставив мене на тверду скелю, щоб я міг ходити, не посковзуючись.

decisions.choice: roaring: the din of rushing water, or ruin
decisions.reason: The word (sha'on) means a roar or uproar, as of the sea (65:8). A pit of roaring may be a pit where water rushes, or, from a related root, a pit of ruin.

decisions.choice: the pit and the mire: near to death
decisions.reason: The pit is a picture of the grave and of deadly danger (28:1; 30:4; 88:5); mud in which one sinks is the same picture (69:3, 15). The rock is its opposite: firm, safe ground.

decisions.choice: so that I could walk without slipping
decisions.reason: Readable says what firm steps mean.

decisions.choice: bor sha'on "騒ぎの穴" (L), "とどろく滅びの穴" (B), "水がごうごうと鳴る深い穴" (R)
decisions.reason: sha'on is the din of rushing water, or ruin (m1, uncertain); the pit and the mire mean being near to death (m2). bor is 穴 (L, B) as the Psalter; Readable follows the English "deep, noisy pit" rather than 死の穴, since the picture is spelled out. sela' 岩 here, not 岩山, because the point is firm footing.

source.text: וַיִּתֵּ֬ן בְּפִ֨י׀שִׁ֥יר חָדָשׁ֮ תְּהִלָּ֪ה לֵֽאלֹ֫הֵ֥ינוּ יִרְא֣וּ רַבִּ֣ים וְיִירָ֑אוּ וְ֝יִבְטְח֗וּ בַּיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he put in my mouth a song new, praise to our God; many will see and fear, and they will trust in YHWH.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} put in my mouth a new song, praise to our God; \q many will see and fear, \q and they will trust in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: He gave me a new song to sing, a hymn for our God. \q Many people will look on and be filled with awe, \q and they will put their trust in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: He gave me a new song to sing, a song that praises our God. \q Many people will see what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done. \q They will be amazed, and they will trust {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a mis dans ma bouche un chant nouveau, une louange à notre Dieu ; \q beaucoup verront et craindront, \q et ils auront confiance en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Il m’a donné un chant nouveau à chanter, un hymne pour notre Dieu. \q Beaucoup regarderont et seront remplis de crainte, \q et ils mettront leur confiance en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Il m’a donné un chant nouveau à chanter, un chant qui loue notre Dieu. \q Beaucoup de gens verront ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait. \q Ils seront émerveillés, et ils feront confiance {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Naye akatia kinywani mwangu wimbo mpya, sifa kwa Mungu wetu; wengi wataona na kuogopa, nao watamtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Alinipa wimbo mpya wa kuimba, wimbo wa kumsifu Mungu wetu. Watu wengi wataona na kujawa na hofu takatifu, nao watamtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Alinipa wimbo mpya wa kuimba, wimbo wa kumsifu Mungu wetu. Watu wengi wataona yale aliyoyatenda. Watashangaa, nao watamtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} puso en mi boca un cántico nuevo, alabanza a nuestro Dios; \q muchos verán y temerán, \q y confiarán en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Él me dio un cántico nuevo para cantar, un himno para nuestro Dios. \q Mucha gente lo verá y se llenará de reverencia, \q y pondrá su confianza en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Él me dio una canción nueva para cantar, una canción que alaba a nuestro Dios. \q Mucha gente verá lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho. \q Se asombrarán, y confiarán en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt trong miệng tôi một bài ca mới, lời ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta; nhiều người sẽ thấy và kính sợ, và họ sẽ tin cậy nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Ngài ban cho tôi một bài ca mới để hát, một bài thánh ca cho Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta. Nhiều người sẽ chứng kiến và đầy lòng kính sợ, và họ sẽ đặt lòng tin cậy nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Ngài ban cho tôi một bài ca mới để hát, một bài ca ngợi khen Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta. Nhiều người sẽ thấy những gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm. Họ sẽ kinh ngạc, và họ sẽ tin cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그분께서 내 입에 새 노래, 우리 하나님께 드리는 찬양을 주셨으니, 많은 사람이 보고 두려워하며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 신뢰할 것이다.
ko.B: 그분께서 나에게 부를 새 노래, 우리 하나님께 드릴 찬송을 주셨다. 많은 사람이 이를 보고 두려워하며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 신뢰하게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그분께서 나에게 부를 새 노래, 우리 하나님을 찬양하는 노래를 주셨다. 많은 사람이 그분께서 하신 일을 보고 놀랄 것이다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 믿을 것이다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} pôs na minha boca um cântico novo, louvor ao nosso Deus; \q muitos verão e temerão, \q e confiarão {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}.
pt.B: Ele me deu um cântico novo para cantar, um hino ao nosso Deus. \q Muitos vão ver e se encher de reverência, \q e vão pôr a sua confiança {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}.
pt.R: Ele me deu um cântico novo para cantar, um cântico de louvor ao nosso Deus. \q Muitas pessoas vão ver o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez. \q Elas vão ficar admiradas e vão confiar {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}.

am.L: በአፌም አዲስ ቅኔን፣ ለአምላካችን ምስጋናን አኖረ፤ ብዙዎች አይተው ይፈራሉ፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}}ም ይታመናሉ።
am.B: የምዘምረው አዲስ መዝሙር፣ ለአምላካችን የምስጋና መዝሙር ሰጠኝ። ብዙ ሰዎች አይተው በፍርሃት ይሞላሉ፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}}ም ይታመናሉ።
am.R: የምዘምረው አዲስ መዝሙር ሰጠኝ፤ አምላካችንን የሚያመሰግን መዝሙር ነው። ብዙ ሰዎች ያደረገውን ያያሉ። ይደነቃሉ፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}}ም ይታመናሉ።

hi.L: और उन्होंने मेरे मुँह में एक नया गीत डाला, हमारे परमेश्वर की स्तुति; बहुत से लोग देखेंगे और भय मानेंगे, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} पर भरोसा रखेंगे।
hi.B: उन्होंने मुझे गाने को एक नया गीत दिया, हमारे परमेश्वर के लिए एक स्तुति-गीत। बहुत से लोग यह देखकर भय और आदर से भर जाएँगे, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} पर भरोसा रखेंगे।
hi.R: उन्होंने मुझे गाने को एक नया गीत दिया, ऐसा गीत जो हमारे परमेश्वर की स्तुति करता है। बहुत से लोग देखेंगे कि उन्होंने क्या किया है। वे चकित होंगे, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} पर भरोसा रखेंगे।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} вложил в уста мои новую песнь, хвалу нашему Богу; многие увидят и убоятся, и будут надеяться на {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Он дал мне новую песнь, хвалебную песнь нашему Богу. Многие увидят это, исполнятся благоговения и доверятся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Он дал мне новую песню — песню, которая хвалит нашего Бога. Многие люди увидят, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сделал. Они будут поражены и станут доверять {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: そして、その方はわたしの口に新しい歌を、わたしたちの神への賛美を授けられた。多くの者が見て、恐れ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に信頼する。
ja.B: その方は、わたしの口に新しい歌を、わたしたちの神への賛美の歌を授けてくださった。多くの人々がそれを見て畏れ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に信頼するようになる。
ja.R: その方は、わたしに新しい歌をくださった。わたしたちの神を賛美する歌だ。多くの人々が、その方のなさったことを見て、驚き恐れ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に信頼するようになる。

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} вклав у мої уста нову пісню, хвалу нашому Богові; багато хто побачить і злякається, і вони покладуться на {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Він дав мені нову пісню, гімн для нашого Бога. Багато людей побачать і сповняться благоговіння, і вони покладуть надію на {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Він дав мені нову пісню, пісню, що хвалить нашого Бога. Багато людей побачать, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зробив. Вони здивуються й довірятимуть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: a new song: a song for a new act of rescue
decisions.reason: A new song answers something new that God has done (33:3; 96:1; 98:1). Here the LORD himself puts it in the singer's mouth.

decisions.choice: see and fear: a play on words
decisions.reason: "They will see" (yir'u) and "they will fear" (yira'u) sound almost alike. To fear the LORD is to stand in awe of him, which leads here to trust.

decisions.choice: what he has done
decisions.reason: Readable says what the many will see: the rescue of verse 3.

decisions.choice: yir'u veyira'u "見て、恐れ" (L), "見て畏れ" (B), "見て、驚き恐れ" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on "see" and "fear" (m2), which Japanese cannot copy; the Psalter's fear words (恐れる L, 畏れる B) are kept, Readable adds amazement as the English "amazed".

source.text: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי הַגֶּ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֣ם יְ֭הֹוָה מִבְטַח֑וֹ וְֽלֹא־פָנָ֥ה אֶל־רְ֝הָבִ֗ים וְשָׂטֵ֥י כָזָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: How blessed [is] the man who has made YHWH his trust, and has not turned to proud [ones] and [those who] fall away [to] falsehood.

en.L: How blessed [is] {{gender:the person|the man}} who has made {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} {{gender:their|his}} trust, \q and has not turned to the proud, \q or to those who stray after falsehood!
en.B: How blessed are those who make {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their trust, \q who do not turn to the arrogant or to those who wander off after lies!
en.R: Life is truly good for people who trust {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q They do not follow proud people, \q or people who turn away to false gods.

fr.L: Heureux {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} qui a fait {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sa confiance, \q et qui ne s’est pas tourné vers les orgueilleux ni vers ceux qui s’égarent dans le mensonge !
fr.B: Heureux ceux qui font {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} leur confiance, \q qui ne se tournent pas vers les arrogants ni vers ceux qui s’égarent à la suite du mensonge !
fr.R: Quel bonheur pour ceux qui font confiance {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! \q Ils ne suivent pas les orgueilleux, \q ni ceux qui se détournent vers de faux dieux.

sw.L: Heri mtu ambaye amemfanya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuwa tumaini lake, wala hakuwageukia wenye kiburi, wala wale wanaopotea kufuata uongo!
sw.B: Ana heri kweli kila anayemfanya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuwa tumaini lake, asiyewageukia wenye majivuno wala wale wanaopotoka kufuata uongo!
sw.R: Maisha ni mema kweli kwa watu wanaomtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hawawafuati watu wenye kiburi, wala watu wanaogeuka kuifuata miungu ya uongo.

es.L: ¡{{gender:Dichosa la persona|Dichoso el hombre}} que ha puesto en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su confianza, \q y no se ha vuelto a los soberbios, \q ni a los que se desvían tras la mentira!
es.B: ¡Qué dichosos son los que ponen su confianza en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q los que no se vuelven hacia los arrogantes ni hacia los que se extravían tras las mentiras!
es.R: Las personas que confían en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} son verdaderamente felices. \q No siguen a la gente orgullosa, \q ni a la gente que se aparta para seguir a dioses falsos.

vi.L: Phước thay người đã lấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm nơi tin cậy của mình, và không quay về với những kẻ kiêu ngạo, hay với những kẻ lạc theo sự giả dối!
vi.B: Phước hạnh thay những người lấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm nơi tin cậy, không quay sang những kẻ kiêu căng hay những kẻ lạc theo điều dối trá!
vi.R: Thật hạnh phúc cho những người tin cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ không theo những kẻ kiêu ngạo, hay những kẻ quay đi theo các thần giả.

ko.L: 얼마나 복된가, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 자기 의지할 곳으로 삼고, 교만한 자들과 거짓을 따라 빗나가는 자들에게로 돌아서지 않는 사람은!
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 의지하는 사람들, 오만한 자들이나 거짓을 좇아 떠도는 자들에게 돌아서지 않는 사람들은 얼마나 복된가!
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 믿는 사람들은 참으로 행복하다. 그들은 교만한 사람들을 따르지 않고, 거짓 신들에게로 돌아서는 사람들도 따르지 않는다.

pt.L: Bem-aventurado [é] {{gender:aquele|o homem}} que fez {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} a sua confiança, \q e não se voltou para os soberbos, \q nem para os que se desviam atrás da mentira!
pt.B: Como são felizes os que fazem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} a sua confiança, \q que não se voltam para os arrogantes nem para os que se desviam atrás de mentiras!
pt.R: Felizes de verdade são as pessoas que confiam {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}. \q Elas não seguem os orgulhosos nem os que se afastam para ir atrás de falsos deuses.

am.L: ምስጉን ነው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} መታመኛው ያደረገ፣ ወደ ትዕቢተኞችና ወደ ሐሰት ወደሚያዘነብሉ ያልዞረ ሰው!
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} መታመኛቸው የሚያደርጉ፣ ወደ ትዕቢተኞች ወይም ውሸትን ተከትለው ወደሚባዝኑ የማይዞሩ እንዴት የተባረኩ ናቸው!
am.R: {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} የሚታመኑ ሰዎች ደስተኞች ናቸው። ትዕቢተኞችን ወይም ወደ ሐሰተኛ አማልክት የሚዞሩ ሰዎችን አይከተሉም።

hi.L: कितना धन्य है वह {{gender:व्यक्ति|आदमी}} जिसने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को अपना भरोसा बनाया है, और जो घमंडियों की ओर, और झूठ के पीछे भटकनेवालों की ओर नहीं मुड़ा!
hi.B: कितने धन्य हैं वे जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को अपना भरोसा बनाते हैं, जो अहंकारियों की ओर, या झूठ के पीछे भटक जानेवालों की ओर नहीं मुड़ते!
hi.R: जो लोग {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} पर भरोसा रखते हैं, उनका जीवन सचमुच अच्छा है। वे घमंडी लोगों के पीछे नहीं चलते, न उन लोगों के पीछे जो झूठे देवताओं की ओर मुड़ जाते हैं।

ru.L: Блажен человек, который сделал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} своей надеждой и не обратился к гордым и к уклоняющимся ко лжи!
ru.B: Блаженны те, кто делает {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} своей надеждой и не обращается к надменным и к тем, кто уходит вслед за ложью!
ru.R: Счастливы люди, которые доверяют {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}. Они не идут за гордыми людьми или за теми, кто отвернулся к ложным богам.

ja.L: 幸いなことよ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を自分の拠り所とし、高ぶる者たちにも、偽りに迷い出る者たちにも向かわない人は。
ja.B: なんと幸いなことか、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を自分の拠り所とし、高ぶる者たちにも、偽りを追って迷い出る者たちにも向かわない人々は。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に信頼する人たちは、本当に幸せだ。彼らは、高ぶる人たちにも、偽りの神々に向かう人たちにも、ついて行かない。

uk.L: {{gender:Блаженна людина, що зробила|Блаженний чоловік, що зробив}} {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} своєю надією і не звернулася до гордих чи до тих, хто блукає за неправдою!
uk.B: Блаженні ті, хто робить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} своєю надією, хто не звертається до пихатих чи до тих, хто відходить за брехнею!
uk.R: Справді добре живеться людям, які довіряють {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}. Вони не йдуть за гордими людьми чи за тими, хто відвертається до фальшивих богів.

decisions.choice: How blessed
decisions.reason: As in 1:1.

decisions.choice: the man: anyone who lives this way
decisions.reason: The word (gever) is a man in his strength, but the blessing is for everyone who trusts the LORD, as in 34:9.

decisions.choice: the proud, falsehood: people who rely on themselves or on lies
decisions.reason: The proud (rehavim) are the arrogant, who trust in themselves. Falsehood (kazav) is a lie; turning aside after it may mean following false gods (Amos 2:4).

decisions.choice: the person, their; "the man", "his" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The words describe anyone who trusts the LORD (m2).

decisions.choice: those, people (plural)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable speak of people in general, which needs no gender setting.

decisions.choice: false gods
decisions.reason: Readable takes the falsehood to be false gods (m3).

decisions.choice: No gender span on "ሰው" and "መታመኛው"
decisions.reason: The English offers "the person ... their" or "the man ... his". "ሰው" and the generic masculine suffix already mean anyone, so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: {{gender:व्यक्ति|आदमी}} (L)
decisions.reason: As the English and as Psalm 34:9: the word means anyone who trusts the LORD (m2). Hindi "अपना" is the same for a man or a woman, so the English span on "their" has no Hindi counterpart; Balanced and Readable speak of people in general.

decisions.choice: "человек", "своей", no gender span
decisions.reason: The man is anyone who lives this way (m2). Russian "человек" and the reflexive "своей" already include anyone, so the English gender span ("the person|the man", "their|his") needs no Russian counterpart.

decisions.choice: 'ashre "幸いなことよ" (L), "なんと幸いなことか" (B), "本当に幸せだ" (R), as the Psalter (PSA-1)
decisions.reason: geber 人, with no gender span for the English {{gender:the person|the man}} and {{gender:their|his}} (L): Japanese 人 is already inclusive.

decisions.choice: rehavim "高ぶる者たち"; satei khazav "偽りに迷い出る者たち" (L), "偽りを追って迷い出る者たち" (B), "偽りの神々に向かう人たち" (R)
decisions.reason: People who rely on themselves or on lies (m3, uncertain); Readable says false gods as the English Readable.

source.text: רַבּ֤וֹת עָשִׂ֨יתָ׀אַתָּ֤ה׀יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַי֮ נִֽפְלְאֹתֶ֥יךָ וּמַחְשְׁבֹתֶ֗יךָ אֵ֫לֵ֥ינוּ אֵ֤ין׀עֲרֹ֬ךְ אֵלֶ֗יךָ אַגִּ֥ידָה וַאֲדַבֵּ֑רָה עָ֝צְמ֗וּ מִסַּפֵּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Many [things] you have done, you, YHWH my God, your wonders and your plans toward us; there is none to compare to you; I would declare and speak [of them]; they are too many to count.

en.L: Many [things] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wonders and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} plans for us; \q there is none to compare with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q [If] I would declare and speak [of them], they are too numerous to count.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done so many things, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wonders and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} plans for us; no one can compare with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}! \q If I tried to tell them all and speak of them, \q there would be more than I could count.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done so many wonderful things for us, and made so many plans for us. \q No one is like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}! \q If I tried to tell about all of them, I could never finish.

fr.L: Nombreuses [sont les choses que] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faites, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} merveilles et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} desseins pour nous ; \q nul ne se compare à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q [Si] je voulais [les] annoncer et [en] parler, elles sont trop nombreuses pour être comptées.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait tant de choses, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} merveilles et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} projets pour nous ; personne ne peut se comparer à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ! \q Si j’essayais de les annoncer et d’en parler, \q il y en aurait plus que je ne pourrais compter.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait tant de choses merveilleuses pour nous, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait tant de projets pour nous. \q Personne n’est comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ! \q Si j’essayais de les raconter toutes, je n’en finirais jamais.

sw.L: Mambo mengi umeyatenda, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na mipango {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwa ajili yetu; hakuna wa kulinganishwa {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}. [Kama] ningeyatangaza na kuyanena, ni mengi mno kuhesabika.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, umetenda mambo mengi sana, maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na mipango {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwa ajili yetu; hakuna anayeweza kulinganishwa {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}! Kama ningejaribu kuyasimulia yote na kuyanena, yangekuwa mengi kuliko ninavyoweza kuhesabu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, umetutendea mambo mengi ya ajabu, na kutupangia mipango mingi. Hakuna aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}! Kama ningejaribu kuyasimulia yote, nisingemaliza kamwe.

es.L: Muchas [cosas] has hecho {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} maravillas y {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} planes para con nosotros; \q no hay quien se compare contigo. \q [Si] yo [las] anunciara y hablara [de ellas], son demasiadas para contarlas.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho tantas cosas, {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} maravillas y {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} planes para nosotros; ¡nadie se puede comparar contigo! \q Si intentara contarlas todas y hablar de ellas, \q serían más de las que podría contar.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho muchísimas cosas maravillosas por nosotros, y has hecho muchísimos planes para nosotros. \q ¡Nadie es como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}! \q Si intentara contarlas todas, nunca terminaría.

vi.L: Nhiều [điều] {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, những việc diệu kỳ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và những ý định của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dành cho chúng tôi; không có ai sánh được với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. [Nếu] tôi muốn rao truyền và nói [về chúng], chúng nhiều quá không đếm được.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm biết bao điều, những việc diệu kỳ và những ý định của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dành cho chúng tôi; không ai có thể sánh được với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Nếu tôi muốn thuật lại và nói hết về chúng, thì chúng nhiều hơn tôi có thể đếm.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm biết bao điều kỳ diệu cho chúng tôi, và đã định biết bao kế hoạch cho chúng tôi. Không ai giống như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Nếu tôi muốn kể hết, tôi sẽ không bao giờ kể xong.

ko.L: 많은 [일들을] 주님께서 행하셨습니다, 주님, {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 저의 하나님, 저희를 향한 주님의 기이한 일들과 주님의 계획들을. 주님과 견줄 이가 없습니다. 제가 [그것들을] 전하고 말하려 해도, 너무 많아서 셀 수 없습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 저의 하나님, 주님께서는 참으로 많은 일을 하셨습니다. 저희를 위한 주님의 놀라운 일들과 계획들이 그러합니다. 누구도 주님과 견줄 수 없습니다! 제가 그것을 다 전하고 말하려 해도, 셀 수 없을 만큼 많습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 저의 하나님, 주님께서는 저희를 위해 놀라운 일을 정말 많이 하셨고, 저희를 위해 많은 계획을 세우셨습니다. 주님과 같은 분은 아무도 없습니다! 제가 그 모든 것을 이야기하려 해도 끝낼 수가 없습니다.

pt.L: Muitas [coisas] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, meu Deus, as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} maravilhas e os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} planos para conosco; \q não há quem se compare a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q [Se] eu [as] anunciasse e falasse [delas], são numerosas demais para contar.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, meu Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste tantas coisas, as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} maravilhas e os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} planos para nós; ninguém se compara a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}! \q Se eu tentasse anunciá-las todas e falar delas, \q seriam mais do que eu poderia contar.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, meu Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste tantas coisas maravilhosas por nós e fizeste tantos planos para nós. \q Ninguém é como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}! \q Se eu tentasse contar todas elas, nunca terminaria.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላኬ ሆይ፣ አንተ ብዙ [ነገሮችን] አደረግህ፤ ድንቆችህንና ለእኛ ያለህን አሳብ፤ ከአንተ ጋር የሚወዳደር የለም፤ ልናገርና ልገልጽ [ብሞክር]፣ ከቁጥር በላይ በዝተዋል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላኬ ሆይ፣ ብዙ ነገሮችን አድርገሃል፤ ድንቅ ሥራዎችህንና ለእኛ ያቀድከውን፤ ከአንተ ጋር የሚወዳደር የለም! ሁሉንም ልነግርና ልናገርባቸው ብሞክር ልቆጥራቸው ከምችለው በላይ ናቸው።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላኬ ሆይ፣ ለእኛ እጅግ ብዙ ድንቅ ነገሮችን አድርገሃል፤ ብዙ ዕቅድም አውጥተህልናል። እንደ አንተ ያለ ማንም የለም! ስለ ሁሉም ልናገር ብሞክር ፈጽሞ አልጨርስም።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरे परमेश्वर, तूने, तूने ही बहुत [काम] किए हैं, तेरे आश्चर्यकर्म और हमारे लिए तेरी योजनाएँ; तेरे समान कोई नहीं। [यदि] मैं उनका वर्णन करूँ और उनकी चर्चा करूँ, तो वे गिनती से बाहर हैं।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरे परमेश्वर, तूने बहुत से काम किए हैं, तेरे आश्चर्यकर्म और हमारे लिए तेरी योजनाएँ; तेरे समान कोई नहीं! यदि मैं उन सबको बताने और उनकी चर्चा करने लगूँ, तो वे इतने हैं कि मैं गिन न सकूँगा।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरे परमेश्वर, तूने हमारे लिए बहुत से अद्भुत काम किए हैं, और हमारे लिए बहुत सी योजनाएँ बनाई हैं। तेरे समान कोई नहीं! यदि मैं उन सबके बारे में बताने लगूँ, तो कभी पूरा न कर पाऊँगा।

ru.L: Многое сделал {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Боже мой, — чудеса {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} и замыслы {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} о нас; нет равного {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. [Если бы] я стал возвещать и говорить [о них], они слишком многочисленны, чтобы их счесть.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Боже мой, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сделал так много — {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} чудеса и {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} замыслы о нас; никто не сравнится с {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}! Если бы я попытался всё рассказать и обо всём говорить, этого было бы больше, чем я могу сосчитать.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Боже мой, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сделал для нас так много чудесного и так много задумал для нас. Нет никого, как {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}! Если бы я попытался рассказать обо всём этом, я бы никогда не закончил.

ja.L: 多くのことを、あなたはなさった、あなた、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、わたしの神よ。あなたの奇しいみわざと、わたしたちへのあなたの計らいを。あなたに並ぶものはない。[もし]わたしが告げ、語ろうとしても、それらは数えきれないほど多い。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、わたしの神よ、あなたは多くのことをなさった。あなたの不思議なみわざ、わたしたちのためのあなたの計らいを。あなたに比べられる者はいない！それを告げ知らせ、語ろうとしても、数えきれないほどだ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、わたしの神よ、あなたは、わたしたちのために、驚くようなことをたくさんしてくださった。わたしたちのために、たくさんの計画を立ててくださった。あなたのような方は、ほかにいない！そのすべてを話そうとしても、とても話しきれない。

uk.L: Багато {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} зробив, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, мій Боже, {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} чудеса і {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} задуми щодо нас; ніхто не зрівняється з {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}}. [Якби] я звіщав і говорив [про них], їх надто багато, щоб полічити.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, мій Боже, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} зробив так багато, {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} чудеса і {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} задуми щодо нас; ніхто не може зрівнятися з {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}}! Якби я спробував розповісти про все й говорити про це, їх було б більше, ніж я можу полічити.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, мій Боже, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} зробив для нас так багато чудового і склав для нас так багато планів. Ніхто не подібний до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}! Якби я спробував розповісти про все це, я ніколи не закінчив би.

decisions.choice: your wonders: deeds only God can do
decisions.reason: The word (nifla'ot) is used of God's great acts, above all the rescue from Egypt (9:2; Exodus 3:20).

decisions.choice: none to compare to you
alternatives: they cannot be set out in order before you
decisions.reason: The words may mean that nothing compares with God (89:7), or that his wonders cannot be laid out in order before him, they are so many. Either way the line goes on to say they cannot be counted.

decisions.choice: If (L in brackets)
decisions.reason: The two verbs are a condition without "if": were I to tell them, they would be too many.

decisions.choice: nifle'otekha "奇しいみわざ" (L), "不思議なみわざ" (B), "驚くようなこと" (R), as 9:2
decisions.reason: Deeds only God can do (m1); the Psalter's wording of 9:2 is kept. 'en 'arokh elekha "あなたに並ぶものはない" follows the English (m2, uncertain; also "none can set them out before you").

source.text: זֶ֤בַח וּמִנְחָ֨ה׀לֹֽא־חָפַ֗צְתָּ אָ֭זְנַיִם כָּרִ֣יתָ לִּ֑י עוֹלָ֥ה וַ֝חֲטָאָ֗ה לֹ֣א שָׁאָֽלְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire; ears you dug for me; burnt offering and sin offering you did not ask.

en.L: Sacrifice and offering {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} did not desire — \q ears {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have dug for me — \q burnt offering and sin offering {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} did not ask for.
en.B: You took no pleasure in sacrifice and offering, \q but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} opened my ears; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} did not ask for burnt offerings or sin offerings.
en.R: You did not really want animal sacrifices and gifts. \q Instead, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made me able to hear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and obey. \q You did not ask for animals to be burned on the altar or offered for sin.

fr.L: Sacrifice et offrande, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’[en] as pas désiré — \q des oreilles, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’en as creusé — ; \q holocauste et sacrifice pour le péché, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’[en] as pas demandé.
fr.B: Tu n’as pas pris plaisir au sacrifice et à l’offrande, \q mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as ouvert les oreilles ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’as pas demandé d’holocaustes ni de sacrifices pour le péché.
fr.R: Tu ne voulais pas vraiment des sacrifices d’animaux et des cadeaux. \q Tu m’as plutôt rendu capable de {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}écouter et de {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}obéir. \q Tu n’as pas demandé qu’on brûle des animaux sur l’autel ou qu’on en offre pour le péché.

sw.L: Dhabihu na sadaka hukuzitaka — masikio umenichimbia — sadaka ya kuteketezwa na sadaka ya dhambi hukuziomba.
sw.B: Hukupendezwa na dhabihu na sadaka, bali umeyafungua masikio yangu; hukuomba sadaka za kuteketezwa wala sadaka za dhambi.
sw.R: Hukutaka hasa dhabihu za wanyama na zawadi. Badala yake, umeniwezesha kukusikia na kutii. Hukuomba wanyama wateketezwe madhabahuni wala watolewe kwa ajili ya dhambi.

es.L: Sacrificio y ofrenda no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agradaron —oídos me has abierto—; \q holocausto y sacrificio por el pecado no pediste.
es.B: No {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} complaciste en sacrificios ni ofrendas, \q pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me abriste los oídos; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no pediste holocaustos ni sacrificios por el pecado.
es.R: En realidad {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no querías sacrificios de animales ni regalos. \q En cambio, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me hiciste capaz de oírte y obedecer. \q No pediste que se quemaran animales en el altar ni que se ofrecieran por el pecado.

vi.L: Sinh tế và lễ vật {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không ưa thích — đôi tai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đào cho tôi — tế lễ thiêu và tế lễ chuộc tội {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã không đòi hỏi.
vi.B: Ngài không vui thích sinh tế và lễ vật, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã mở tai tôi; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không đòi tế lễ thiêu hay tế lễ chuộc tội.
vi.R: Ngài không thật sự muốn những sinh vật tế lễ và quà dâng. Thay vào đó, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho tôi có thể nghe {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và vâng lời. Ngài không đòi con vật bị thiêu trên bàn thờ hay được dâng để chuộc tội.

ko.L: 제사와 예물을 주님께서 원하지 않으셨습니다. 귀를 주님께서 저에게 파 주셨습니다. 번제와 속죄제를 주님께서 요구하지 않으셨습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 제사와 예물을 기뻐하지 않으셨지만, 제 귀를 열어 주셨습니다. 번제나 속죄제를 요구하지도 않으셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 짐승의 제물과 예물을 정말로 원하지는 않으셨습니다. 그 대신 제가 주님의 말씀을 듣고 순종할 수 있게 해 주셨습니다. 제단에서 짐승을 태워 드리는 제물이나 죄를 위한 제물을 요구하지 않으셨습니다.

pt.L: Sacrifício e oferta não quiseste — \q ouvidos {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} cavaste para mim — \q holocausto e oferta pelo pecado não pediste.
pt.B: Sacrifício e oferta não quiseste, \q mas abriste os meus ouvidos; \q holocaustos e ofertas pelo pecado não pediste.
pt.R: Tu não quiseste de verdade sacrifícios de animais e ofertas. \q Em vez disso, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me deste ouvidos para {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ouvir e obedecer. \q Tu não pediste animais queimados no altar nem ofertas pelo pecado.

am.L: መሥዋዕትንና መባን አልፈለግህም፤ ጆሮዎችን ቆፈርክልኝ፤ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትንና የኃጢአት መሥዋዕትን አልጠየቅህም።
am.B: በመሥዋዕትና በመባ ደስ አልተሰኘህም፤ ነገር ግን ጆሮዎቼን ገለጥክልኝ፤ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትንና የኃጢአት መሥዋዕትን አልጠየቅህም።
am.R: የእንስሳት መሥዋዕትንና ስጦታን በእርግጥ አልፈለግህም። ይልቁንም እንድሰማህና እንድታዘዝህ አደረግኸኝ። በመሠዊያ ላይ የሚቃጠሉ ወይም ስለ ኃጢአት የሚቀርቡ እንስሳትን አልጠየቅህም።

hi.L: बलिदान और भेंट तूने न चाही — तूने मेरे लिए कान खोदे हैं — होमबलि और पापबलि तूने न माँगी।
hi.B: बलिदान और भेंट तूने नहीं चाही, पर तूने मेरे कान खोल दिए; होमबलियाँ और पापबलियाँ तूने नहीं माँगीं।
hi.R: तूने सचमुच पशुओं के बलिदान और भेंटें नहीं चाहीं। इसके बदले तूने मुझे ऐसा बनाया कि मैं तेरी सुनूँ और तेरी बात मानूँ। तूने नहीं माँगा कि पशु वेदी पर जलाए जाएँ या पाप के लिए चढ़ाए जाएँ।

ru.L: Жертвы и приношения {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} не захотел — уши {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} выкопал мне, — всесожжения и жертвы за грех {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} не просил.
ru.B: Жертвы и приношения {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} не пожелал, но {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} открыл мне уши; всесожжений и жертв за грех {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} не просил.
ru.R: Ты не хотел жертв и приношений. Вместо этого {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сделал так, чтобы я мог слышать {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} и слушаться. Ты не просил, чтобы животных сжигали на жертвеннике или приносили в жертву за грех.

ja.L: いけにえと供え物を、あなたはお望みにならなかった――耳を、あなたはわたしのために掘られた――焼き尽くすささげ物と罪のための[ささげ物]を、あなたはお求めにならなかった。
ja.B: あなたは、いけにえも供え物もお喜びにならず、わたしの耳を開いてくださった。焼き尽くすささげ物も、罪を償うささげ物も、お求めにならなかった。
ja.R: あなたが本当に望んでおられたのは、動物のいけにえや供え物ではなかった。その代わりに、あなたは、わたしがあなたの言葉を聞いて従えるようにしてくださった。祭壇で焼かれる動物も、罪のためのささげ物も、あなたはお求めにならなかった。

uk.L: Жертви й приношення {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} не захотів — вуха {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} викопав мені — всепалення й жертви за гріх {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} не просив.
uk.B: Тобі не до вподоби жертви й приношення, але {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} відкрив мені вуха; {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} не просив усепалень чи жертв за гріх.
uk.R: Ти насправді не хотів жертвоприношень тварин і дарів. Натомість {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} дав мені змогу чути {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} й слухатися. Ти не просив спалювати тварин на жертовнику чи приносити їх за гріх.

decisions.choice: ears you dug for me: you made me able to hear and obey
alternatives: you pierced my ear (as a servant for life)
decisions.reason: To dig out ears is to open them, so that a person truly listens; in Hebrew to hear is also to obey (1 Samuel 15:22). Some see the ear of a servant pierced at the door as a mark of service for life (Exodus 21:6), but that uses a different word.

decisions.choice: sacrifice you did not desire: obedience comes first
decisions.reason: The four words cover the main offerings of the law. The psalm does not reject them; it says that what God wants first is a listening, willing heart (1 Samuel 15:22; 51:18-19; Hosea 6:6).

decisions.choice: Hebrews 10:5-7: a body you prepared for me
decisions.reason: Hebrews 10:5-7 quotes verses 7-9 as the words of Christ coming into the world, from the ancient Greek translation, which reads "a body you prepared for me" instead of "ears you dug for me". The Hebrew text is followed here.

decisions.choice: made me able to hear you and obey
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m1).

decisions.choice: "sadaka ya kuteketezwa" for burnt offering and "sadaka ya dhambi" for sin offering (L, B), as in the Pentateuch; Readable describes them
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch terms are kept so that readers can see the psalm speaking of the same offerings as the Law; Readable says what was done with the animals, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: oídos me has abierto
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says God "dug" ears for the psalmist. Spanish "cavar" said of ears would sound only strange, so Literal says "abierto", which keeps the picture of ears made able to hear; the meaning decision explains the image.

decisions.choice: the words of Hebrews 10:5-7 where the Hebrew is the same; "ouvidos" where Hebrews has "um corpo"
decisions.reason: Hebrews 10:5-7 quotes verses 7-9 from the ancient Greek translation (m3). Its Portuguese is kept where the Hebrew says the same: "Sacrifício e oferta não quiseste" (L, B), "Tu não quiseste ... sacrifícios e ofertas" (R), "holocaustos e ofertas pelo pecado", "Eis que venho; no rolo do livro está escrito a meu respeito" (L) and "a tua vontade" at every level. The psalm follows the Hebrew where the Greek differs: "ouvidos" dug or opened for me, not "um corpo me preparaste"; "não pediste" for the burnt offerings; and in verse 8 Balanced and Readable say that the scroll tells the psalmist what to do (m1 there), where Hebrews hears "about me".

decisions.choice: The Hebrew "ears you have dug for me" ("ጆሮዎችን ቆፈርክልኝ", L) is kept, not Hebrews 10:5's "a body you prepared for me" ("አካልን አዘጋጀህልኝ")
decisions.reason: Hebrews 10:5-7 quotes verses 7-9 from the Greek (the Septuagint), which reads "a body you prepared"; the Hebrew has "ears you have dug", that is, you made me able to hear and obey (m1). The Amharic follows the Hebrew, and keeps the New Testament's words where the two agree: "መሥዋዕትንና መባን አልፈለግህም" (L), "የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት" and "የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት". Where Hebrews says God "took no pleasure" in them, the Hebrew says he "did not ask for" them ("አልጠየቅህም").

decisions.choice: "तूने मेरे लिए कान खोदे हैं" (L); "तूने मेरे कान खोल दिए" (B); "मुझे ऐसा बनाया कि मैं तेरी सुनूँ" (R); not Hebrews 10:5's "एक देह तैयार की"
decisions.reason: Hebrews 10:5-7 quotes verses 7-9 from the Greek Old Testament, which reads "a body you prepared for me" (in this translation "पर मेरे लिए एक देह तैयार की"). The Hebrew says "ears you have dug for me" (m1, m3), and the Hindi translates the Hebrew; where the Hebrew says the same as Hebrews ("बलिदान और भेंट तूने न चाही", "होमबलि", "पापबलि", and verses 8-9), it keeps Hebrews' wording at each level.

decisions.choice: "уши ты выкопал мне" (L); "ты открыл мне уши" (B); "сделал так, чтобы я мог слышать тебя и слушаться" (R)
decisions.reason: Hebrews 10:5-7 quotes verses 7-9 from the Greek Old Testament, which reads "a body you prepared for me" (in Russian Hebrews "тело ты приготовил мне", "тело ты уготовил мне", "ты создал тело для меня"). The psalm translates the Hebrew, "ears you have dug for me": you made me able to hear and obey (m1). Where the Hebrew says the same as Hebrews, the Russian keeps Hebrews' words at each level ("Жертвы и приношения ты не захотел"; "не пожелал"; "Ты не хотел жертв и приношений"; "Вот, я пришёл"; "исполнить ... твою волю").

decisions.choice: 'aznayim karita li "耳を、あなたはわたしのために掘られた" (L), "わたしの耳を開いてくださった" (B), "聞いて従えるようにしてくださった" (R); not HEB 10:5's "体を備えてくださった"
alternatives: わたしのために体を備えてくださった (HEB 10:5)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says ears were dug, i.e. God made me able to hear and obey (m1, uncertain); Hebrews 10:5 quotes the Greek "a body you prepared for me" (m3, footnoted), so the Japanese follows the Hebrew here while sharing Hebrews' words for the offerings (いけにえと供え物, 焼き尽くすささげ物, 罪のための[ささげ物] L, 罪を償うささげ物 B).

decisions.choice: chafatsta / sha'alta "お望みにならなかった" / "お求めにならなかった"
decisions.reason: Negatives for God take お〜にならない, not 〜られなかった, which can read "could not" (PSA-1).

source.text: אָ֣ז אָ֭מַרְתִּי הִנֵּה־בָ֑אתִי בִּמְגִלַּת־סֵ֝֗פֶר כָּת֥וּב עָלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Then I said, Here I have come; in [the] scroll of [the] book [it is] written concerning me.

en.L: Then I said, "Look, I have come; \q in the scroll of the book [it is] written concerning me.
en.B: Then I said, "Here I come! \q What I must do is written down for me in the scroll of the book.
en.R: So I said, "I am here; I have come. \q The scroll of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} book tells me what I must do.

fr.L: Alors j’ai dit : « Voici, je suis venu ; \q dans le rouleau du livre [il est] écrit à mon sujet.
fr.B: Alors j’ai dit : « Me voici, je viens ! \q Ce que je dois faire est écrit pour moi dans le rouleau du livre.
fr.R: Alors j’ai dit : « Je suis là, je suis venu. \q Le rouleau de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} livre me dit ce que je dois faire.

sw.L: Ndipo niliposema, "Tazama, nimekuja; katika gombo la kitabu [ime]andikwa habari zangu.
sw.B: Ndipo niliposema, "Mimi hapa, ninakuja! Yale ninayopaswa kufanya yameandikwa kwa ajili yangu katika gombo la kitabu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nilisema, "Mimi niko hapa; nimekuja. Gombo la kitabu {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} linaniambia ninachopaswa kufanya.

es.L: Entonces dije: «Mira, he venido; \q en el rollo del libro [está] escrito acerca de mí.
es.B: Entonces dije: «¡Aquí vengo! \q Lo que debo hacer está escrito para mí en el rollo del libro.
es.R: Así que dije: «Aquí estoy; he venido. \q El rollo de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} libro me dice lo que debo hacer.

vi.L: Bấy giờ tôi nói: "Kìa, tôi đến; trong cuộn sách [có] chép về tôi.
vi.B: Bấy giờ tôi nói: "Này, tôi đến đây! Điều tôi phải làm đã được chép cho tôi trong cuộn sách.
vi.R: Vậy tôi nói: "Tôi đây; tôi đã đến. Cuộn sách của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho tôi biết điều tôi phải làm.

ko.L: 그때 제가 말하였습니다. "보십시오, 제가 왔습니다. 두루마리 책에 저에 관하여 기록되어 [있습니다].
ko.B: 그때 제가 말했습니다. "제가 여기 왔습니다! 제가 해야 할 일이 두루마리 책에 저를 위해 기록되어 있습니다.
ko.R: 그래서 저는 말했습니다. "제가 여기 있습니다. 제가 왔습니다. 주님의 두루마리 책이 제가 해야 할 일을 저에게 알려 줍니다.

pt.L: Então eu disse: "Eis que venho; \q no rolo do livro [está] escrito a meu respeito.
pt.B: Então eu disse: "Aqui estou, eu venho! \q O que devo fazer está escrito para mim no rolo do livro.
pt.R: Então eu disse: "Aqui estou; eu vim. \q O rolo do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} livro me diz o que devo fazer.

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ እንዲህ አልኩ፦ «እነሆ፣ መጥቻለሁ፤ በመጽሐፍ ጥቅልል ስለ እኔ ተጽፏል፤
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ እንዲህ አልኩ፦ «ይኸው መጥቻለሁ! ማድረግ ያለብኝ በመጽሐፉ ጥቅልል ተጽፎልኛል።
am.R: ስለዚህ እንዲህ አልኩ፦ «እዚህ ነኝ፤ መጥቻለሁ። የመጽሐፍህ ጥቅልል ማድረግ ያለብኝን ይነግረኛል።

hi.L: तब मैंने कहा, "देख, मैं आया हूँ; पुस्तक की पोथी में मेरे विषय में लिखा है।
hi.B: तब मैंने कहा, "देख, मैं आया हूँ! मुझे जो करना है, वह पुस्तक की पोथी में मेरे लिए लिखा है।
hi.R: इसलिए मैंने कहा, "मैं यहाँ हूँ; मैं आया हूँ। तेरी पुस्तक की पोथी मुझे बताती है कि मुझे क्या करना है।

ru.L: Тогда я сказал: «Вот, я пришёл; в свитке книги написано обо мне.
ru.B: Тогда я сказал: «Вот, я пришёл! В свитке книги написано, что я должен делать.
ru.R: И я сказал: «Вот я, я пришёл. В свитке {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} книги написано, что я должен делать.

ja.L: その時、わたしは言った。「ご覧ください、わたしは来た。巻物の書に、わたしについて書かれている。
ja.B: その時、わたしは言った。「今、わたしはここに来た。わたしがなすべきことは、巻物の書に記されている。
ja.R: そこで、わたしは言った。「わたしはここにいる。わたしは来た。あなたの書の巻物に、わたしがすべきことが書いてある。

uk.L: Тоді я сказав: «Ось я прийшов; у сувої книги написано про мене.
uk.B: Тоді я сказав: «Ось я йду! Те, що я маю зробити, записано для мене в сувої книги.
uk.R: Тож я сказав: «Ось я; я прийшов. Сувій {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} книги каже мені, що я маю робити.

decisions.choice: written concerning me: written for me to do
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean what is prescribed for a person, as in 2 Kings 22:13, "all that is written concerning us", which suits verse 9. Hebrews 10:7 hears it as "written about me".

decisions.choice: the scroll of the book: God's written instruction
decisions.reason: Books were written on scrolls. Here it is most likely the law of God (verse 9), which a king was to keep by him and read (Deuteronomy 17:18-19).

decisions.choice: the speech runs into verse 9
decisions.reason: What the psalmist said continues to the end of verse 9.

decisions.choice: your book
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear it is God's book (m2).

decisions.choice: "በዚያን ጊዜ እንዲህ አልኩ፦", "መጥቻለሁ", "በመጽሐፍ ጥቅልል ... ተጽፏል", "ፈቃድህን ላደርግ" as Hebrews 10:7 on main
decisions.reason: The Amharic keeps the words of Hebrews 10:7 where the Hebrew agrees. It follows the Hebrew where the Greek is shorter: "my God" ("አምላኬ ሆይ", not "እግዚአብሔር ሆይ"), "I delight" to do your will, and the line "your instruction is within me" in verse 9, which Hebrews leaves out. "Look" is "እነሆ" at Literal only, as the New Testament.

decisions.choice: "देख, मैं आया हूँ"; "पुस्तक की पोथी में मेरे विषय में लिखा है" (L)
decisions.reason: As Hebrews 10:7 in this translation. The speech runs into verse 9 (m3), so the quotation opens here and closes at the end of verse 9, as in the English.

decisions.choice: "Тогда я сказал: «Вот, я пришёл"
decisions.reason: The words of Hebrews 10:7 in Russian ("Тогда я сказал: “Вот, я пришёл"), kept where the Hebrew says the same. Here the speaker is the psalmist, so there are no deity_pronoun spans on "я" as there are in Hebrews.

decisions.choice: hinneh-va'ti "ご覧ください、わたしは来た" (L), "今、わたしはここに来た" (B), "わたしはここにいる。わたしは来た" (R); not HEB 10:7's "見よ"
alternatives: 見よ、わたしは来た (HEB 10:7 L)
decisions.reason: The Psalter never writes 見よ for hinneh (PSA-1); spoken to God it is ご覧ください at Literal. The speech opens here and closes at the end of 40:9 (m3), as the English.

decisions.choice: katuv 'alai "わたしについて書かれている" (L, as HEB 10:7), "わたしがなすべきことは…記されている" (B), "わたしがすべきことが書いてある" (R)
decisions.reason: "Written concerning me" may be "written for me to do" (m1, uncertain, footnoted); Literal keeps the words Hebrews uses, Balanced and Readable the English sense.

records.literal_gloss: To do your will, my God, I delight, and your instruction [is] in [the] midst of my inner parts.

en.L: To do {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} will, my God, I delight, \q and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction [is] within my inmost being."
en.B: My God, I love to do what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want; \q {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction is deep inside me."
en.R: My God, I am glad to do what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want. \q Your teaching is deep inside me."

fr.L: Faire {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} volonté, mon Dieu, voilà mon plaisir, \q et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi [est] au-dedans de mes entrailles. »
fr.B: Mon Dieu, j’aime faire ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veux ; \q {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction est au fond de moi. »
fr.R: Mon Dieu, je suis heureux de faire ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veux. \q Ton enseignement est au fond de moi. »

sw.L: Kufanya mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, Mungu wangu, ninafurahia, na sheria {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} [iko] ndani ya utu wangu wa ndani."
sw.B: Mungu wangu, ninapenda kufanya yale unayotaka; mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yamo ndani kabisa mwangu."
sw.R: Mungu wangu, ninafurahi kufanya yale unayotaka. Mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yamo ndani kabisa mwangu."

es.L: Hacer {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} voluntad, Dios mío, me deleita, \q y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción [está] dentro de mi ser más íntimo».
es.B: Dios mío, me encanta hacer lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quieres; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción está muy dentro de mí».
es.R: Dios mío, me alegra hacer lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quieres. \q Tu enseñanza está muy dentro de mí».

vi.L: Làm theo ý muốn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi vui thích, và sự dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [ở] trong thâm tâm tôi."
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi thích làm điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn; lời dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở sâu trong lòng tôi."
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi vui mừng làm điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn. Lời dạy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở sâu trong lòng tôi."

ko.L: 주님의 뜻을 행하기를, 저의 하나님, 제가 기뻐합니다. 주님의 가르침이 제 속 깊은 곳에 [있습니다]."
ko.B: 저의 하나님, 저는 주님께서 원하시는 일을 하기를 좋아합니다. 주님의 가르침이 제 마음 깊은 곳에 있습니다."
ko.R: 저의 하나님, 저는 주님께서 원하시는 일을 기쁘게 합니다. 주님의 가르침이 제 마음 깊이 있습니다."

pt.L: Em fazer a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} vontade, meu Deus, eu me deleito, \q e o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} ensino [está] no íntimo do meu ser."
pt.B: Meu Deus, eu amo fazer a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} vontade; \q o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} ensino está dentro de mim."
pt.R: Meu Deus, fico feliz em fazer a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} vontade. \q Os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} ensinamentos estão bem dentro de mim."

am.L: አምላኬ ሆይ፣ ፈቃድህን ላደርግ ደስ ይለኛል፤ ሕግህም በአንጀቴ መካከል [ነው]።»
am.B: አምላኬ ሆይ፣ ፈቃድህን ማድረግ እወዳለሁ፤ ሕግህ በውስጤ ጥልቅ ነው።»
am.R: አምላኬ ሆይ፣ የምትፈልገውን ማድረግ ደስ ያሰኘኛል። ትምህርትህ በልቤ ጥልቅ ውስጥ ነው።»

hi.L: हे मेरे परमेश्वर, तेरी इच्छा पूरी करने में मुझे आनंद है, और तेरी व्यवस्था मेरे अंतर्मन में [है]।"
hi.B: हे मेरे परमेश्वर, मुझे तेरी इच्छा पूरी करना प्रिय है; तेरी व्यवस्था मेरे मन की गहराई में है।"
hi.R: हे मेरे परमेश्वर, मैं तेरी इच्छा पूरी करके आनंदित होता हूँ। तेरी शिक्षा मेरे मन में गहरी बसी है।"

ru.L: Исполнить волю {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}}, Боже мой, я желаю, и Закон {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} — в глубине моего существа.»
ru.B: Боже мой, я люблю исполнять {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} волю; {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} Закон — глубоко внутри меня.»
ru.R: Боже мой, я рад делать то, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} хочешь. Твоё наставление — глубоко внутри меня.»

ja.L: わたしの神よ、あなたのみこころを行うことを、わたしは喜びとする。あなたの教えは、わたしのはらわたの内に[ある]。」
ja.B: わたしの神よ、わたしは、あなたのみこころを行うことを喜ぶ。あなたの教えは、わたしの心の奥深くにある。」
ja.R: わたしの神よ、わたしは、あなたが望まれることを、喜んでする。あなたの教えは、わたしの心の奥にある。」

uk.L: Чинити {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} волю, мій Боже, я прагну, і {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} настанова — всередині мого нутра.»
uk.B: Мій Боже, я люблю чинити те, чого {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} хочеш; {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} настанова — глибоко в мені.»
uk.R: Мій Боже, я радо роблю те, чого {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} хочеш. Твоє навчання — глибоко в мені.»

decisions.choice: instruction
decisions.reason: As in 1:2 (torah).

decisions.choice: in the midst of my inner parts: in my heart
decisions.reason: The inner parts (me'im) are the deepest self, where feeling and will are. The instruction is not only on a scroll but taken to heart (37:31; Jeremiah 31:33).

decisions.choice: Hebrews 10:7
decisions.reason: Hebrews 10:7-9 ends its quotation with "to do your will, O God" and sees it fulfilled in Christ.

decisions.choice: "तेरी इच्छा पूरी करना"; "व्यवस्था" (L, B), "शिक्षा" (R)
decisions.reason: "To do your will" keeps the words of Hebrews 10:7 in this translation ("तेरी इच्छा पूरी करूँ") (m3). God's torah is "व्यवस्था" at Literal and Balanced and "शिक्षा" at Readable, as the poetry note settles.

decisions.choice: "Закон" (L, B); "наставление" (R)
decisions.reason: God's torah (m1), in the poetry note's forms, as in 37:31.

decisions.choice: retsonkha "あなたのみこころ" (L, B), as HEB 10:7; torat "教え" (every level)
decisions.reason: Hebrews 10:7 quotes this line (m3) and its みこころを行う is kept; torah is the Psalter's 教え (PSA-1, m1); "in the midst of my inner parts" is in my heart (m2), はらわた at Literal.

source.text: בִּשַּׂ֤רְתִּי צֶ֨דֶק׀בְּקָ֘הָ֤ל רָ֗ב הִנֵּ֣ה שְׂ֭פָתַי לֹ֣א אֶכְלָ֑א יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַתָּ֥ה יָדָֽעְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: I have told good news [of] righteousness in [the] great assembly; look, my lips I do not hold back; YHWH, you know.

en.L: I have told the good news of righteousness in [the] great assembly; \q look, my lips I do not hold back; \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know.
en.B: In the great assembly I have announced the good news of righteousness. \q I have not held my lips back; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know it, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: When {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people met together, \q I told them the good news that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do what is right. \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know that I did not keep quiet.

fr.L: J’ai annoncé la bonne nouvelle de la justice dans [la] grande assemblée ; \q voici, je ne retiens pas mes lèvres ; \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le sais.
fr.B: Dans la grande assemblée j’ai annoncé la bonne nouvelle de la justice. \q Je n’ai pas retenu mes lèvres ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le sais, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Quand {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple s’est réuni, je lui ai annoncé la bonne nouvelle : \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais ce qui est juste. \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sais que je ne me suis pas tu.

sw.L: Nimetangaza habari njema ya haki katika kusanyiko kubwa; tazama, midomo yangu siizuii; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unajua.
sw.B: Katika kusanyiko kubwa nimetangaza habari njema ya haki. Sikuizuia midomo yangu; unalijua hilo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walipokutana pamoja, niliwaambia habari njema kwamba {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} hutenda yaliyo haki. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unajua kwamba sikunyamaza.

es.L: He anunciado la buena noticia de [la] justicia en [la] gran asamblea; \q mira, mis labios no he refrenado; \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [lo] sabes.
es.B: En la gran asamblea he anunciado la buena noticia de la justicia. \q No he refrenado mis labios; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} lo sabes, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo se reunió, \q les conté la buena noticia de que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} haces lo que es justo. \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} sabes que no me quedé callado.

vi.L: Tôi đã rao tin lành về sự công chính trong hội chúng lớn; kìa, môi tôi tôi không kìm giữ; lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết.
vi.B: Trong đại hội chúng tôi đã loan báo tin lành về sự công chính. Tôi không hề khép môi lại; lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết điều đó.
vi.R: Khi dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhóm lại, tôi đã báo cho họ tin mừng rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm điều đúng. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết tôi đã không im lặng.

ko.L: 제가 큰 회중 가운데서 의의 기쁜 소식을 전하였습니다. 보십시오, 제가 제 입술을 막지 않습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 아십니다.
ko.B: 큰 회중 가운데서 저는 의의 기쁜 소식을 알렸습니다. 제 입술을 다물지 않았습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 그것을 아십니다.
ko.R: 주님의 백성이 함께 모였을 때, 저는 주님께서 옳은 일을 하신다는 기쁜 소식을 그들에게 전했습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 잠잠히 있지 않았다는 것을 주님께서 아십니다.

pt.L: Anunciei as boas-novas da justiça na grande assembleia; \q eis que os meus lábios não retenho; \q {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [o] sabes.
pt.B: Na grande assembleia anunciei as boas-novas da justiça. \q Não fechei os meus lábios; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} o sabes, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Quando o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo se reuniu, \q eu contei a todos a boa notícia de que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fazes o que é certo. \q {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sabes que eu não fiquei calado.

am.L: በታላቅ ጉባኤ የጽድቅን የምሥራች ነገርኩ፤ እነሆ፣ ከንፈሮቼን አልከለክልም፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አንተ ታውቃለህ።
am.B: በታላቅ ጉባኤ የጽድቅን የምሥራች አበሠርኩ። ከንፈሮቼን አልገታሁም፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አንተ ታውቃለህ።
am.R: ሕዝብህ በተሰበሰበ ጊዜ ትክክል የሆነውን እንደምታደርግ የምሥራቹን ነገርኳቸው። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ዝም እንዳላልኩ ታውቃለህ።

hi.L: मैंने बड़ी मंडली में धार्मिकता का शुभ समाचार सुनाया है; देख, मैं अपने होंठ नहीं रोकता; हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तू जानता है।
hi.B: बड़ी मंडली में मैंने धार्मिकता का शुभ समाचार सुनाया है। मैंने अपने होंठों को नहीं रोका; हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तू यह जानता है।
hi.R: जब तेरे लोग इकट्ठे हुए, तब मैंने उन्हें यह शुभ समाचार सुनाया कि तू वही करता है जो सही है। हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तू जानता है कि मैं चुप नहीं रहा।

ru.L: Я благовествовал праведность в великом собрании; вот, уст моих я не удерживаю; {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} знаешь.
ru.B: В великом собрании я возвестил радостную весть о праведности. Я не сдерживал своих уст; {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} знаешь это, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Когда {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} народ собирался вместе, я рассказывал людям радостную весть о том, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} поступаешь справедливо. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} знаешь, что я не молчал.

ja.L: わたしは大いなる集いの中で、義の良い知らせを告げた。なんと、わたしは唇を押しとどめない。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたはご存じだ。
ja.B: 大いなる会衆の中で、わたしは義の良い知らせを伝えた。わたしは唇を閉ざさなかった。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたはそれをご存じだ。
ja.R: あなたの民が集まったとき、わたしは、あなたが正しいことをなさるという良い知らせを伝えた。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしが黙っていなかったことを、あなたは知っておられる。

uk.L: Я звіщав добру вістку про праведність у великому зібранні; ось своїх губ я не стримую; {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} знаєш.
uk.B: У великому зібранні я оголосив добру вістку про праведність. Я не стримував своїх губ; {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} знаєш це, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Коли {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} народ збирався разом, я розповідав їм добру новину, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} чиниш правильно. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} знаєш, що я не мовчав.

decisions.choice: told good news
decisions.reason: The verb (bisser) is to bring good news, as a messenger does (Isaiah 40:9; 52:7).

decisions.choice: righteousness: God's right acts of rescue
decisions.reason: The righteousness he announces is the LORD's: his faithful, just way of putting things right by saving his people (verse 11).

decisions.choice: the great assembly: the people gathered for worship
that you do what is right
decisions.reason: Readable says whose righteousness it is (m2).

decisions.choice: told good news (bisser) as "የምሥራች ነገርኩ" (L), "የምሥራች አበሠርኩ" (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is the Hebrew word for bringing good news; "ወንጌል" is kept for the gospel of the New Testament, and "የምሥራች" says the plain sense.

decisions.choice: "благовествовал" (L); "возвестил радостную весть" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to tell good news (m1), the word the Greek Old Testament renders with the verb of the gospel. Literal uses "благовествовать", as Acts does at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "радостная весть", in lower case since it is not the Christian Gospel here.

decisions.choice: bissarti tsedeq "義の良い知らせを告げた" (L), "義の良い知らせを伝えた" (B), "あなたが正しいことをなさるという良い知らせ" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is to bring good news (m1), of God's right acts of rescue (m2); 良い知らせ rather than the NT term 福音. 'ekhla' 押しとどめない (L) is echoed by God's 押しとどめる in 40:12 (the play of m1 there).

source.text: צִדְקָתְךָ֬ לֹא־כִסִּ֨יתִי׀בְּת֬וֹךְ לִבִּ֗י אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ וּתְשׁוּעָתְךָ֣ אָמָ֑רְתִּי לֹא־כִחַ֥דְתִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ לְקָהָ֥ל רָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: Your righteousness I have not hidden in [the] midst of my heart; your faithfulness and your salvation I have spoken; I have not concealed your loyal love and your truth from [the] great assembly.

en.L: Your righteousness I have not hidden within my heart; \q {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation I have spoken; \q I have not concealed {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth from [the] great assembly.
en.B: Your justice I did not keep shut up in my heart; \q I talked of how faithful {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are and how {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} rescue. \q Your loyal love and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth I did not hide from the great assembly.
en.R: I did not keep to myself how good and fair {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are. \q I told people that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are faithful and that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} save. \q I did not hide {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people when they gathered.

fr.L: Ta justice, je ne l’ai pas cachée au-dedans de mon cœur ; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut, je les ai dits ; \q je n’ai pas dissimulé {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vérité à [la] grande assemblée.
fr.B: Ta justice, je ne l’ai pas tenue enfermée dans mon cœur ; \q j’ai dit combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fidèle et comment {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sauves. \q Ton amour fidèle et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vérité, \q je ne les ai pas cachés à la grande assemblée.
fr.R: Je n’ai pas gardé pour moi combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es bon et juste. \q J’ai dit aux gens que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fidèle et que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sauves. \q Je n’ai pas caché {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vérité à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple quand il était réuni.

sw.L: Haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} sikuificha ndani ya moyo wangu; uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} nimeunena; sikuuficha upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma na kweli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} mbele ya kusanyiko kubwa.
sw.B: Haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} sikuifungia moyoni mwangu; nilisimulia jinsi ulivyo mwaminifu na jinsi unavyookoa. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma na kweli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} sikuvificha mbele ya kusanyiko kubwa.
sw.R: Sikuficha moyoni jinsi ulivyo mwema na wa haki. Niliwaambia watu kwamba {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mwaminifu na kwamba unaokoa. Sikuuficha upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma na kweli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} mbele ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walipokusanyika.

es.L: Tu justicia no he escondido dentro de mi corazón; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fidelidad y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvación he proclamado; \q no he ocultado {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} verdad a [la] gran asamblea.
es.B: Tu justicia no la guardé encerrada en mi corazón; \q hablé de lo fiel que eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} y de cómo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} rescatas. \q Tu amor fiel y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} verdad no los oculté a la gran asamblea.
es.R: No me guardé para mí lo bueno y justo que eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}. \q Le dije a la gente que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres fiel y que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} salvas. \q No escondí {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel ni {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} verdad de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo cuando se reunía.

vi.L: Sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tôi không giấu trong lòng; sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tôi đã nói ra; tôi không che giấu tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và chân lý của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trước hội chúng lớn.
vi.B: Tôi không giữ kín sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong lòng; tôi đã nói về sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu. Tình yêu thương thành tín và sự chân thật của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tôi không giấu đại hội chúng.
vi.R: Tôi không giữ riêng cho mình việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tốt lành và công bằng thế nào. Tôi đã nói cho mọi người biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thành tín và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu. Tôi không giấu dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, khi họ nhóm lại, về tình thương không hề thay đổi và sự chân thật của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주님의 의를 제가 제 마음속에 숨기지 않았고, 주님의 신실하심과 주님의 구원을 제가 말하였으며, 주님의 한결같은 사랑과 주님의 진실을 큰 회중에게 감추지 않았습니다.
ko.B: 주님의 의로우심을 제 마음속에 가두어 두지 않았고, 주님께서 얼마나 신실하시며 어떻게 구원하시는지 말했습니다. 주님의 한결같은 사랑과 진실을 큰 회중에게 감추지 않았습니다.
ko.R: 저는 주님께서 얼마나 선하고 공정하신지 혼자만 알고 있지 않았습니다. 주님께서 신실하시고 구원하시는 분이라고 사람들에게 말했습니다. 주님의 백성이 모였을 때, 주님의 변함없는 사랑과 진실을 그들에게 숨기지 않았습니다.

pt.L: A {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} justiça não escondi dentro do meu coração; \q a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fidelidade e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} salvação proclamei; \q não ocultei o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} verdade da grande assembleia.
pt.B: Não guardei a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} justiça fechada no meu coração; \q falei da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fidelidade e de como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvas. \q Não escondi da grande assembleia o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} verdade.
pt.R: Eu não guardei só para mim como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és bom e justo. \q Contei às pessoas que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és fiel e que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvas. \q Não escondi o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor fiel e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} verdade do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo reunido.

am.L: ጽድቅህን በልቤ ውስጥ አልሰወርኩም፤ ታማኝነትህንና ማዳንህን ተናገርኩ፤ ጽኑ ፍቅርህንና እውነትህን ከታላቅ ጉባኤ አልደበቅኩም።
am.B: ጽድቅህን በልቤ ዘግቼ አላስቀመጥኩም፤ ምን ያህል ታማኝ እንደ ሆንክና እንዴት እንደምታድን ተናገርኩ። ጽኑ ፍቅርህንና እውነትህን ከታላቁ ጉባኤ አልሸሸግኩም።
am.R: አንተ ምን ያህል ደግና ትክክለኛ እንደ ሆንክ ለራሴ ብቻ አልያዝኩም። ታማኝ እንደ ሆንክና እንደምታድን ለሰዎች ነገርኩ። ሕዝብህ በተሰበሰበ ጊዜ ጽኑ ፍቅርህንና እውነትህን አልደበቅኩባቸውም።

hi.L: तेरी धार्मिकता को मैंने अपने हृदय में नहीं छिपाया; तेरी सच्चाई और तेरे उद्धार की चर्चा मैंने की है; तेरे अटल प्रेम और तेरे सत्य को मैंने बड़ी सभा से नहीं छिपाया।
hi.B: तेरे न्याय को मैंने अपने मन में बंद करके नहीं रखा; मैंने बताया कि तू कितना विश्वासयोग्य है और कैसे उद्धार करता है। तेरे अटल प्रेम और तेरे सत्य को मैंने बड़ी मंडली से नहीं छिपाया।
hi.R: मैंने यह बात अपने तक नहीं रखी कि तू कितना भला और न्यायी है। मैंने लोगों को बताया कि तू विश्वासयोग्य है और तू उद्धार करता है। जब तेरे लोग इकट्ठे हुए, तब मैंने तेरे अटल प्रेम और तेरे सत्य को उनसे नहीं छिपाया।

ru.L: Праведности {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} я не скрывал в сердце моём; о верности {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} и спасении {{deity_pronoun:твоём|Твоём}} я говорил; не утаил я {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви и {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} истины от великого собрания.
ru.B: Твою справедливость я не держал взаперти в своём сердце; я говорил о том, как {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} верен и как {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} спасаешь. Твою неизменную любовь и {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} истину я не скрывал от великого собрания.
ru.R: Я не держал в себе то, как {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} добр и справедлив. Я говорил людям, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} верен и что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} спасаешь. Я не скрывал {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} неизменную любовь и {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} истину от {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} народа, когда он собирался.

ja.L: あなたの義を、わたしは心の内に隠さず、あなたの真実とあなたの救いを語った。あなたの誠実とあなたのまことを、大いなる集いに隠さなかった。
ja.B: あなたの義を、わたしは心の中にしまい込まず、あなたがどれほど真実な方か、どのように救ってくださるかを語った。あなたの変わらぬいつくしみとまことを、大いなる会衆に隠さなかった。
ja.R: あなたが、どれほど正しく公平な方かを、わたしは胸にしまっておかなかった。あなたが真実な方で、救ってくださる方だと、人々に話した。あなたの変わらぬいつくしみと真実を、集まったあなたの民に隠さなかった。

uk.L: Твоєї праведності я не сховав у своєму серці; про {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} вірність і {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} спасіння я говорив; я не приховав {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} незмінної любові й {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} істини від великого зібрання.
uk.B: Твоєї справедливості я не тримав замкненою в серці; я говорив про те, який {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вірний і як {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} рятуєш. Твоєї незмінної любові й {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} істини я не ховав від великого зібрання.
uk.R: Я не тримав у собі, який {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} добрий і справедливий. Я розповідав людям, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вірний і що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} спасаєш. Я не ховав {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} вірної любові й {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} правди від {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} народу, коли він збирався.

decisions.choice: loyal love: faithful, covenant love
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith within a bond, here the LORD's love for his people. Literal and Balanced say "loyal love", Readable "faithful love".

decisions.choice: not hidden, not concealed: openly told
decisions.reason: Saying what he did not do is a strong way of saying what he did: he told it all, out loud. The verse takes up "I do not hold back" from verse 10.

decisions.choice: faithfulness, truth: God can be relied on
decisions.reason: Both words ('emunah, 'emet) come from the root of "amen": what is firm and holds.

decisions.choice: "सच्चाई" (L), "विश्वासयोग्य" (B, R) for 'emunah; "अटल प्रेम" (hesed); "सत्य" ('emet)
decisions.reason: The poetry note's words, as in Psalm 36:6: God's faithfulness ('emunah) is "सच्चाई" at Literal and "विश्वासयोग्यता" at Balanced and Readable; his hesed is "अटल प्रेम" at every level; his truth ('emet) is "सत्य".

decisions.choice: chasdekha va'amittekha "あなたの誠実とあなたのまこと" (L), "あなたの変わらぬいつくしみとまこと" (B), "あなたの変わらぬいつくしみと真実" (R); 'emunatekha "真実"
decisions.reason: The Psalter's chesed ve'emet (PSA-1) and 'emunah 真実 (m1, m3).

source.text: אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה לֹא־תִכְלָ֣א רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ תָּמִ֥יד יִצְּרֽוּנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: You, YHWH, will not withhold your compassion from me; your loyal love and your truth continually will guard me.
